name: sap-b1-middleware-connector
description: Middleware connector for SAP B1 integration with Replit cloud application

scripts.test: node -e "console.log('Testing SAP B1 connection...'); require('./sap-connector').testConnection().then(() => console.log('✅ SAP connection successful')).catch(err => console.error('❌ SAP connection failed:', err.message))"
scripts.test-replit: node -e "console.log('Testing Replit connection...'); require('./sync-service').testReplitConnection().then(() => console.log('✅ Replit connection successful')).catch(err => console.error('❌ Replit connection failed:', err.message))"
scripts.sync-now: node -e "require('./sync-service').syncAllData().then(result => console.log('Sync completed:', result)).catch(err => console.error('Sync failed:', err.message))"

author: Thermopac Engineering
